<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Are you an ambitious student looking to specialize in <strong>trustworthy and reliable artificial intelligence</strong>? The <strong>Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable AI (relAI)</strong> is now accepting applications for its <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong> in Germany. This prestigious program, hosted by the <strong>Technical University of Munich (TUM)</strong> and <strong>Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU)</strong>, offers an excellent scholarship opportunity for students passionate about <strong>safety, security, privacy, and responsibility in AI systems</strong>.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">If you hold an excellent bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or related fields, this fully-funded enhancement to a regular master’s degree could be your gateway to becoming a future leader in <strong>Reliable AI</strong>.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Overview of the Konrad Zuse School relAI MSc Scholarship Program</h2>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong> is not a separate degree but a <strong>specialized add-on track</strong> to a standard master’s program at either TUM or LMU Munich. It provides a <strong>coherent, flexible, and personalized training</strong> that goes beyond conventional AI education. Students receive cross-disciplinary training that combines:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list has-medium-font-size">
<li>Advanced scientific and technical coursework in reliable AI.</li>



<li>Professional development programs.</li>



<li>Direct industrial exposure and networking opportunities.</li>



<li>Research integration with leading AI experts.</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The program focuses on five key research areas: <strong>Mathematical and Algorithmic Foundations, Algorithmic Decision-Making, Medicine and Healthcare, Robotics and Interacting Systems, and Learning and Instruction</strong>.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Benefits of the relAI MSc Scholarship Program </h2>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Successful applicants to the <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong> receive substantial financial and academic support. The scholarship benefits include:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list has-medium-font-size">
<li><strong>Monthly scholarship of up to €992</strong> (depending on independent income).</li>



<li><strong>Travel grants</strong>, including support for home travel.</li>



<li>Access to world-class research resources at TUM and LMU.</li>



<li>Enhanced mentorship from leading AI researchers.</li>



<li>Industry exposure and networking with top AI companies in Germany.</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">This financial support allows students to focus entirely on their studies and research in <strong>Reliable AI</strong> without worrying about living expenses.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Eligibility</h2>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">To apply for the <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong>, you must meet the following criteria:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An excellent bachelor’s degree in one of these disciplines:
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Computer Science</li>



<li>Mathematics</li>



<li>Engineering</li>



<li>Natural Sciences</li>



<li>Data Science / Machine Learning / AI-related disciplines</li>
</ul>
</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Interest in Reliable AI:</strong> A genuine interest in working on topics such as <strong>safety, security, privacy, and responsibility</strong> in AI systems.</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Research Alignment:</strong> Your interest should align with at least one of relAI’s research areas (Mathematical and Algorithmic Foundations, Algorithmic Decision-Making, Medicine & Healthcare, Robotics & Interacting Systems, or Learning & Instruction).</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>English Proficiency:</strong> Certified proficiency in English (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS).</li>
</ul>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">How To Apply</h2>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Follow these steps to submit your application for the <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong>:</p>



<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Visit the official relAI website</strong> (Link Below)</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Review the admission requirements</strong> for the regular master’s program at TUM or LMU. You must be eligible for admission to a standard MSc at one of these universities.</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Prepare your documents:</strong>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Bachelor’s degree certificate and transcripts.</li>



<li>Proof of English proficiency.</li>



<li>Letter of motivation explaining your interest in <strong>Reliable AI</strong>.</li>



<li>Curriculum Vitae (CV).</li>



<li>Any other documents specified on the official application portal.</li>
</ul>
</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Complete the online application form</strong> before the deadline.</li>



<li class="has-medium-font-size"><strong>Submit your application</strong> and keep a copy for your records.</li>
</ol>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Application Deadline</h2>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The deadline for the <strong>relAI MSc Program 2026</strong> is: <strong>15 June 2026 </strong></p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">Late or incomplete applications will not be considered. It is highly recommended to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.</p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"><strong><a href="https://zuseschoolrelai.de/application/#MSc-Program-Application" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">CLICK HERE TO APPLY NOW >>></a></strong></p>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph"></p>



<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Conclusion</h3>



<p class="has-medium-font-size wp-block-paragraph">The <strong>Konrad Zuse School relAI MSc Program 2026 in Germany</strong> is a <strong>golden opportunity</strong> for students who want to shape the future of <strong>trustworthy artificial intelligence</strong>. With a generous scholarship of up to €992 per month, world-class training at TUM and LMU Munich, and a strong focus on <strong>AI safety, security, and responsibility</strong>, this program prepares you for a high-impact career in academia or industry.</p>
